item.title: More than half of adults in U.S. say they lack basic statistical understanding
item.description:
📝 Slightly more than one-quarter said they had learned some statistics in school. This does not mean that people do not believe statistics matter, Ramos said. Nine out of 10 participants said they would use statistics more if they possessed more understanding.
